lines.b: Grander earth has quaked before
Moved by the sound of His voice
Seas that are shaken and stirred
Can be calmed and broken for my regard
And far be it from me to not believe
Even when my eyes can't see
And this mountain that's in front of me
Will be thrown into the midst of the sea

lines.a: 帶領我 帶領我 眼光專注祢
lines.b: And through it all, through it all My eyes are on You

lines.a: 帶領我 帶領我 得安息
lines.b: And through it all, through it all It is well
